description: Vue.js component definition for a folder tree in a media management application, including methods for folder operations and drag-and-drop media movement.

classes.name: folder
classes.description: Vue.js component for folder tree with drag-and-drop and folder management functionalities.

methods.name: isAncestorOfSelectedFolder
methods.description: Checks if the current folder is an ancestor of the selected folder.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the open/closed state of the folder node.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the folder and loads its children.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Emits event to request folder creation.

methods.name: deleteFolder
methods.description: Emits event to request folder deletion.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child folders via AJAX call.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Handles drag over event, sets hover state.

methods.name: handleDragLeave
methods.description: Handles drag leave event, resets hover state.

methods.name: moveMediaToFolder
methods.description: Moves media items to the specified folder via AJAX, with confirmation.
